name: Cut uniform pieces
short_description: Use a kitchen knife to cut 20 pieces within a five-millimetre size range.
self_assessment: I can cut 20 food pieces within five millimetres of one size without help.
description: Use a kitchen knife to cut 20 pieces within a five-millimetre size range. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Cut 20 vegetable pieces to a consistent size
safety_note: Sharp blades can cause cuts; use a stable board, keep fingers clear, cut away from the body, and stop if control is lost.
